name: office-wifi-portal
description: Office Wi-Fi login — static UI template

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const files=['login.html','alogin.html','status.html','logout.html','css/main.css','js/main.js','assets/logo.svg'];let ok=true;for(const f of files){if(!fs.existsSync(f)){console.error('Missing: '+f);ok=false;}}if(ok){console.log('All template files verified. Build passed.');}else{process.exit(1);}"
